# Ridgetown Heating & Cooling

> Serving Ridgetown and the wider Chatham-Kent region, Ridgetown Heating & Cooling is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (548) 708-7251  |  Email: contact@ridgetownheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://ridgetownheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Ridgetown, Bothwell, Dresden, Highgate, Wallaceburg
